card.label: H.J.Res. 213
card.summary: H.J. Res. 213 is a joint resolution that uses the Congressional Review Act to disapprove and nullify a specific rule issued by the Environmental Protection Agency. The rule in question granted partial authorization to the California Air Resources Board to enforce its Commercial Harbor Craft regulations.
card.title: Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule issued by the Environmental Protection Agency relating to the "California State Nonroad Engine Pollution Control Standards; Commercial Harbor Craft Regulations; Notice of Decision".
